decls.name: Erdos249257.twentyOneFatalAlignedBranch_eventually_affine_supercapacity
decls.sig:
theorem twentyOneFatalAlignedBranch_eventually_affine_supercapacity
    (hbranch : TwentyOneFatalAlignedBranch) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ R : ℕ, K ≤ R →
      twentyOneEvenQuotientGreedySupport (R + 1) =
          insert (R + 1) (twentyOneEvenQuotientGreedySupport R) ∧
        twentyOneEvenQuotientGreedyRemainder (R + 1) =
          (4 * twentyOneEvenQuotientGreedyRemainder R +
              twentyOneTargetTwoStepPulse (2 * R) -
                localPrefixTwoStepPulse
                  (twentyOneEvenQuotientGreedySupport R) (2 * R)) -
            (2 ^ (R + 1) + 1)

decls.name: ErdosProblems.Erdos257.PaperCompleteR20.paper_terminalhalf_iff
decls.sig:
theorem paper_terminalhalf_iff :
    (∃ B : Set ℕ, 0 ∉ B ∧ B.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 B = (1 : ℝ) / 2) ↔
      ∃ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (A : ℕ → Set ℕ),
        (∀ j, 1 ≤ M j) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto M Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
          (∀ j n, n ∈ A j → 2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ M j) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun j ↦ |(terminalPaperCarry (A j) (M j) : ℝ)| / (2 : ℝ) ^ M j)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

res:weighted-cover-incomparability.label: Proposition 5.1 (incomparable support criteria)
res:weighted-cover-incomparability.note: The two Lean statements supply the two hosts separately, with a positive support written as 0∉E0 otin E and a cover satisfying (V) indexed from 00. exists_weighted_not_strengthened_host gives an infinite EE with E∈𝒲2E\in\mathcal W_2 and E∉𝒞E otin\mathcal C; exists_strengthened_not_old_or_weighted_host gives an infinite VV with V∈𝒞V\in\mathcal C, V∉𝒲bV otin\mathcal W_b for every integer b≥2b\ge2, and non-summable reciprocals, which for nonnegative terms is ∑a∈V1/a=∞\sum_{a\in V}1/a=\infty. Each adds further conclusions. The Lean host VV is a squarefree divisor-cube host with its own row schedule; the bounded-mass fresh-prime construction printed in the proof is an ordinary proof.

decls.name: ErdosProblems.Erdos257.PaperCompleteR8.exists_weighted_not_strengthened_host
decls.sig:
theorem exists_weighted_not_strengthened_host :
    ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ 0 ∉ A ∧ FinitePrimeWeighted 2 A ∧
      ¬ Summable (Set.indicator A (fun a : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / a)) ∧
      ¬ HasStrengthenedPositiveCover A ∧ IsEmpty (LogBudgetCover A) ∧
      (∀ B : Set ℕ, B ⊆ A → B.Infinite → ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b →
        Irrational (erdosSupportSeries b B))

decls.name: ErdosProblems.Erdos257.PaperCompleteR8.exists_strengthened_not_old_or_weighted_host
decls.sig:
theorem exists_strengthened_not_old_or_weighted_host :
    ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ 0 ∉ A ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, Squarefree a) ∧
      HasStrengthenedPositiveCover A ∧ ¬ HasOldPositiveCover A ∧
      (¬ Summable (Set.indicator A (fun a : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / a))) ∧
      (∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ¬ FinitePrimeWeighted b A) ∧
      (∀ B : Set ℕ, B ⊆ A → B.Infinite → ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b →
        Irrational (erdosSupportSeries b B))

res:weighted-support.label: Theorem 1.2 (a weighted condition on the support)
res:weighted-support.note: The Lean statements have the same hypotheses and conclusions as the printed ones, with A⊆ℕ>0A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0} written as 0∉A0\notin A and Wb,P(A)<∞W_{b,P}(A)<\infty written as summability over AA for some finite nonempty set PP of primes. The fixed-base statement and, under (W), irrationality at every b≥2b\ge2 for every infinite subset are the two parts of divisibilityWeightedClaim; heredity under the fixed-base condition is finitePrimeWeighted_fixedBase_hereditary.

decls.name: ErdosProblems.Erdos257.PaperCompleteR8.finitePrimeWeighted_fixedBase_hereditary
decls.sig:
theorem finitePrimeWeighted_fixedBase_hereditary
    (b : ℕ) (H : Set ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hH0 : 0 ∉ H)
    (hH : FinitePrimeWeighted b H) :
    ∀ A : Set ℕ, A ⊆ H → A.Infinite →
      Irrational (erdosSupportSeries b A)
